title: Conservation and restoration of plastic objects

photo.caption: A variety of plastic objects conserved in a museum (Finland)
Over several years, plasticizers in a soft vinyl eraser have migrated to partially dissolve a plastic pen cap.
photo.description: The eraser sat forgotten in a box in the basement for several years. (no exposure to heat!) The contained in the eraser dissolved the plastic tube lying on it to such an extent that it slowly deformed as if it had melted.

rights.fileTitle: File:Plastic lamp cord - brittle after 50 yrs.jpg

photo.fileTitle: File:Plastic lamp cord - brittle after 50 yrs.jpg
photo.caption: Loss of plasticizers over 50 years caused embrittlement of electrical lampcord.
photo.description: Loss of plasticizers due to diffusion and evaporation eventually leads to the hardening of the plastic insulation, to the point that the slightest flexing causes the plastic to crumble apart.
